text_block_list.text: I visited a shrine with Cesario, who had been in a slump lately...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It's nice and quiet here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
What is that...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: An e-uma for wishes...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I want to open my own shop"... "Pass college entrance exams!",
"I want to make up with my friend"...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wishes really do come in
all shapes and sizes, don't they?
choice_data_list: There are some that look like Tracen Academy students.
There are some that look like Tracen Academy students, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Faster than anyone"...
"I'll definitely run in a GⅠ!"...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Tracen Academy is not forgiving enough
for someone to keep attending without emotional support.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why, by giving it physical form like this, she is making a vow to herself."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "And then, I ask God to 'please watch over me' as I give it my all."
choice_data_list: Then should we write something too?
Then shall we write something too?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, indeed.
If only to look deep into my own heart once more.
Together with Cesario, I wrote our wishes on the ema and hung them up.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what did you write?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The moment you hung it up, it ceased to be a secret. Let's see here—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Fulfill my pupil's dream"...
Heheh, honestly, you are quite something.
choice_data_list: Speaking of which, what did Cesario write?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Running!
I wanna get faster!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
On a biiiig racetrack!
I wanna go zooming by!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. To build an era where kids like them
can chase their dreams even more than now.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "I want the achievements and experience for that. That is my wish right now."

Cesario gave a bright smile at the innocent wish of the young worshipper.
From that day forward, her condition began to turn for the better.

I looked around for an e-uma
to write down my wish, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It seems there's no one in the shrine office either.
Looks like we'll have to give up for today.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in wishing for what we can't have.
Shall we head back soon?
"I was hoping this would help Cesario get back in top form... but it seems my expectations were off."
